blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Сейчас три часа, а мне к пяти надо быть на ___ (юбилейный) обеде.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.why: «The Instrumental without С is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.» — DLI, Lesson 30. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The Instrumental without С is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.» — DLI, Lesson 30.

exercises.why: «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks, «Genitive case». From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks,…

exercises.q: Дайте мне консоме! — ___ (приказать / приказывать) он половому.
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Говорят, что ___ (есть / съесть) также болезни, когда много едят…»
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Закажи порцию селянки из ___ (осетрина) по-русски и… и…
exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: Съел пять ___ (куски) теста и еще просит!
exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case». From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много,…

exercises.q: Половой поставил перед соседом гору ___ (блины) и две тарелки с балыком и сёмгой.
exercises.why: «The genitive case is used to denote the possessor or owner … A noun in the genitive case is sometimes used to qualify (modify) another noun.» — DLI, Lesson 23. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The genitive case is used to denote the possessor or owner … A noun in the genitive case is sometimes used to qualify (modify) another noun.» — DLI, Lesson 23.

exercises.q: От ___ (порция) до порции изволь ждать полчаса!
exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: От порции до ___ (порция) изволь ждать полчаса!
exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.q: Как же мне не есть, если я с ___ (сам) утра ничего не ел?
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: К ___ (великое) удивлению Пуркуа, ел он их спеша, едва разжёвывая, как голодный…
exercises.why: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.

exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Благообразный господин выпил рюмку водки, закусил семгой и принялся за ___ (блины).
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Подашь ___ (бутылка) Нюи… — сказал сосед, принимая от полового икру и лук.
exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18. From Антон Чехов, «Глупый француз».
exercises.context: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.
